name: as if through glass
source:
High school freshman Anise enters her spring semester during an unseasonable, unceasing rain. Girls’* relationships float through the waves of time as it passes with or without them.  

[From [url=https://ebicon.itch.io/as-if-through-glass]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
高中一年级新生安妮丝在一场反常的持续不断的雨中进入了春季学期。女孩*的关系随着时间的推移而漂浮，无论有没有她们。

[来自[url=https://ebicon.itch.io/as-if-through-glass]itch.io[/url]]
